_description: Anarchy Online breed reference data: creation base abilities, IP-trainable ability caps, HP/nano modifiers, and breed traits. Ability ids match AOSharp.Common.GameData.Stat (Strength=0x10 .. Psychic=0x15).
_notes: creationBase = the ability values a fresh level-1 character of that breed starts with (before profession/IP spend).
trainedAbilityCap = the maximum each ability can be raised to via IP (the breed 'cap' used by character planners). Both AO-Universe and wiki.aodb.us agree on these level-200 cap values.
hpPerBodyDev / nanoPerNanoPool = how many Max Health per point of Body Development, and Max Nano per point of Nano Pool, for that breed.

AO-Universe additionally lists a higher second figure per ability (e.g. Atrox Str '512 / 912*') interpreted as an absolute level-220 maximum including external buffs/items; that interpretation is not fully confirmed here and is recorded under maxAbility220Unverified.

UNVERIFIED: Nanomage Sense creationBase is reported as 4 by wiki.aodb.us/wiki/Abilities but as 6 in an anarchyonline.fandom.com Breed snippet; Atrox Psychic creationBase (3) likewise varies in some community sources (6). Verify against client character-creation data if exact base values matter.

breeds.name: Solitus
traits: The balanced 'human' baseline breed: no ability strongly favoured and no ability strongly penalised.
All ability caps sit near 480, giving the most even/flexible build with no glaring weakness.

breeds.name: Opifex
traits: Highest Agility cap (544) and high Sense cap (512): favours evades, ranged and stealth playstyles.
Strong for Fixers, Agents, Martial Artists and other agility/sense professions.
Lower Strength and Psychic caps than other breeds.

breeds.name: Nanomage
traits: Highest Intelligence and Psychic caps (512): the caster/nano breed.
Gains the most Max Nano per Nano Pool point (4) and the highest nano-cost-reduction cap (55%).
Gains the least Max Health per Body Development point (2) and lowest Strength/Stamina caps: fragile in melee.
creationBase Sense flagged unverified (reported as 4 or 6 across sources).

breeds.name: Atrox
traits: Highest Strength and Stamina caps (512) and the most Max Health per Body Development point (4): the tank/melee breed.
Has innate access to the Brawl and Dimach special-attack skills as a breed feature.
Lowest mental caps (Int/Sense/Psychic capped at 400) and least nano per Nano Pool point (2): weak nano casting and mental/tradeskills.
Genderless breed; creationBase Psychic (3) varies in some community sources.

_sources: https://www.ao-universe.com/guides/classic-ao/gameplay-guides-6/breed-statistics (ability caps, HP/nano-per-point modifiers, deltas, nano-cost-reduction caps)
http://wiki.aodb.us/wiki/Abilities (level-1 creation base ability values per breed)
https://anarchyonline.fandom.com/wiki/Breed (breed trait descriptions; conflicting Nanomage Sense base = 6)
